.. _cdi:

CDI
===

CDI (Certificado de Depósito Interbancário / Interbank Deposit Certificate) is an interest rate applied to short-term interbank loans with high liquidity (typically overnight), used to balance banks' cash positions.

This metric is considered the minimum acceptable return for fixed-income investments and serves as a benchmark for performance, as it closely follows the Selic rate and is strongly correlated with inflation.

- CDI Sections:

   - :ref:`Download CDI Data <download_cdi>`
   - :ref:`Valuation CDI Data <valuation_cdi>`
